profile_intent: Hyperpop and bright sample-based material: control painful resonances without erasing intentional brightness, synthetic texture, or lead focus.
genre_rules: Bright high end can be intentional; detect painful resonances before cutting air.
Prefer dynamic control for 3-8 kHz shards and 10-16 kHz fake fizz.
Do not over-smooth AI texture if it is part of the style.
Protect vocal and lead intelligibility against de-essing and side cleanup.
